@expo/ui.comment: iOS and Android only: the platform's own controls (RowActions.ios.tsx, RowActions.android.tsx). Web and macOS never load it.

react-dom.comment: Only needed by web consumers — used by createPortal in SchemaEditor + DragGhost. Native consumers (Expo, RN-macOS) don't install it. Drop once the Portal abstraction lands and these imports become conditional.

react-native.comment: Only needed by native consumers — used by useViewportWidth on iOS/Android/macOS. Web consumers use the `.web.ts` variant which uses window.innerWidth. Vite's resolve.extensions resolves `.web.ts` ahead of `.ts` so RN is never reached on web.

react-native-gesture-handler.comment: Native-only — used by DragHandle.tsx for drag gesture recognition (PanResponder doesn't track motion continuously on RN-macOS). Web uses DragHandle.web.tsx with pointer events and doesn't need RNGH.

expo-haptics.comment: iOS and Android only: the feel of a touch and hold (RowActions.ios.tsx, RowActions.android.tsx). Web and macOS never load it.

react-native-ios-context-menu.comment: iOS only: a row's context menu (RowActions.ios.tsx). Pinned: 3.2.1 is published as source only (no lib/), so a patch could change its shape.

react-native-ios-utilities.comment: iOS only: react-native-ios-context-menu's native base. Pinned with it.

expo-symbols.comment: iOS and Android only: a boolean cell's symbol (Toggle.ios.tsx, Toggle.android.tsx). Web and macOS never load it.

react-native-screens.comment: iOS only: a view's settings as a form sheet with detents (Sheet.ios.tsx). Web, macOS and Android never load it.

@legendapp/list.comment: Web for now: a table draws only the rows on screen (RowList.web.tsx). Native follows with LARGE-TABLES-PLAN I1.
